dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: Now that you mention it, I did see a few shiny ores nearby. Perhaps they're some sort of Crystal Ore?

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: You can go have a look if you're interested, I think they were located at...

dialogues.speaker: Doolan
dialogues.text: There, I've marked them out on your map. I mean, note-taking is a skill that every adventurer must have, no?
